scripts.copy:docs: mkdir -p dist/design/logos dist/explainers && cp ../docs/status.html dist/status.html && cp ../docs/decision-flow.html dist/decision-flow.html && cp ../docs/explainers/*.html dist/explainers/ && cp ../docs/design/logos/resfi-brand.svg dist/design/logos/resfi-brand.svg
scripts.build:web: expo export --platform web && npm run copy:docs
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
